clue.text: Female force motivated half of them subsequently

explanation.surface: A woman spurring on a group, with only half of them following afterwards.
explanation.walkthrough: 'motivated' rearranges FORCE to CEFOR, and 'half of' keeps TH from THEM.
explanation.definitionFit: Both mean from this point on in time, a formal synonym for afterwards.

clue.text: The writer gets so healthy, picking up example of long life

clue.text: Stolen silverware and kitchen item
